set.body:
VERIFIED: the package has no data/ directory and no inst/ directory at all (ls confirms both absent). Nothing is lazy-loadable, nothing is reachable via data(), and there is no inst/extdata fixture.

Consequence, traced through every user-facing surface:

  README.md:49-58        run1 <- rbind(face = c(2, 1, 0.5, -0.5, 0, 1), ...)
  introduction.Rmd:48-57 the identical hand-typed 3x6 matrix
  evidence-pairing.Rmd:41-55 session1 <- cbind(trend, -0.85 * trend + c(...), sin(...), cos(...))

Every entry point into this package starts by asking the reader to type numbers that stand in for data. A reader never once sees effectagram touch anything with the shape, scale, or noise structure of fMRI. The 6-feature domain in the introduction is smaller than any real searchlight, so the reader also cannot calibrate what the package costs or what its output looks like at a realistic size.

This is distinct from the Rd-example question claude-review closed at pass 46. That was about whether an executable journey EXISTS; plan_crossnobis.Rd shows one does. This is about whether a journey exists that starts from something recognizable as data. Those are different failures. An executable example over a synthetic 4x4 matrix demonstrates the API; it does not let a researcher recognize their own experiment in the documentation.

The cost is concentrated at first contact. A reader deciding in 60 seconds whether this package is for them sees toy matrices and cannot tell whether the framework scales, whether it handles their design, or what a result means.

PROPOSED (not yet agreed - sequencing matters, see the R CMD check ordering point from pass 42):
  a small shipped dataset with a real experimental shape - conditions x voxels x runs,
  documented provenance, either simulated with a declared generative model or a
  de-identified real excerpt. Large enough to be recognizable, small enough for CRAN
  (well under the 5 MB budget). Once it exists it serves the README, both vignettes,
  and the first-journey Rd examples from one source.

NOTE FOR WHOEVER IMPLEMENTS: a shipped dataset enlarges the R CMD check surface, and the certification chain currently rests on a tarball SHA whose tree is uncommitted (bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED). Do not add data/ before that bead is resolved, or the certified artifact and the tree diverge further.
set.title: No shipped example dataset: every documented journey begins with a hand-typed matrix
